occurrences.text: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
